statistics.normal_scope: Old/new normal angle is a deformation diagnostic, not a self-intersection or invariant orientation certificate.

saved_source.topology_scope: Exact original control topology/associations and native triangle indices; inherited original one-component closed oriented topology, no added components.
saved_source.combination: Xfinal=Xoriginal+saved_original_mask*(Xexact_revised_replay−Xoriginal). Exact replay interior with feathered transition; outside mask original XYZ is byte-identical.

hierarchy.profile: Same saved unwrapped k phase; primary parents k1,k4, width .70, union of exp(-distance^4)
hierarchy.method: Enhance selected primary saved MIDDLE contribution, retain 80-100% of actual late LINKED/WIDE contributions.
hierarchy.scope: Saved contribution reweighting with verified neutral CC lift of MIDDLE; not a regenerated G1-G7 growth recipe.

fine.sampling: sampling_gain=min(1,((pi/2)/max_actual_incident_edge_abs_delta_psi)^2); positive, continuous amplitude attenuation, no binary surface support or warpage mask.
fine.displacement_filter: Exactly one .5*new_delta+.5*uniform_actual_edge_neighbor_mean(new_delta); actual source geometry is not averaged.
fine.edge_sample_scope: Every 32nd quad in deterministic 65536-face chunks; all edges used for actual amplitude attenuation.
fine.limits: Same inherited field direction, pitch, sampling attenuation and endfade. Actual render decides visual quality; global self-intersections remain unchecked.
fine.generation_scope: Derived linear amplitude scaling only. No new normal evaluation, phase, mask, averaging, or hierarchy generation.

validation.native_fan_centres: Arithmetic mean of actual amplified carrier quad corners; no independent centre lift.
validation.connectivity: Exact original G7 native fan indices; no added subdivision or topology.

validation.no_orphan_scope: Both private old parent ridge IDs are reused by child0. Every appended grid center, midpoint and child ridge ID is referenced by the four-child disks or conforming neighbor split.
validation.topology_scope: Four-child disk has the original oriented boundary split at shared original-edge midpoints; the two old edge incidences conform to the same midpoint. Source closed one-component connectivity is inherited without global edge sorting.
validation.limits: No global collision, self-intersection or fabrication certificate. This local native finish is not an additional global Catmull-Clark generation.
